title: Thirteen Reasons Why
author: Jay Asher
summary: Clay receives a box of cassette tapes from Hannah Baker, a classmate who has died by suicide. Each tape explains how one person contributed to her decision, and he must listen to find out where he fits.
readIf: you want a quick, emotional story about how small actions affect others, and are comfortable with the subject.
skipIf: you are sensitive to suicide, assault or are in a fragile place; it is intense and at times controversial.

pairings.reason: A quieter, more hopeful novel about the effects of an assault and the pressure to stay silent.
A teen narrator confronting trauma, with more warmth and healing.
Another young adult story that keeps death in view while looking at how people connect.
